cohort: 68 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed CHD delivered by elective cesarean section and 147 healthy newborns matched for delivery route, maternal age, and gestational week
finding: Newborns with CHD had significantly lower Apgar scores at 1, 5, and 10 minutes compared to healthy controls, but there were no significant differences in umbilical cord blood gas parameters between groups.
birth_weight: Similar between CHD and control groups
